behavior: No implicit FX conversion or 1 USDT = 1 USD assumption; original fiat amountMinor and ISO currency stay separate from provider atomic quote.
USDT asset fixed; chain/token reference/decimals/minimum confirmations must be explicit configuration. Atomic amounts use bounded canonical strings; all monetary arithmetic is BigInt.
Quote interval is [issuedAt, expiresAt); exact UTC microseconds are preserved. Both first and last included payment times must be inside it. Later confirmations may arrive after expiry.
Wrong identity/asset/network/token/decimals, underpayment, overpayment, reorg, late payment and expired unpaid quote receive explicit REVIEW reasons. Confirmation shortage stays PENDING.
Even exact confirmed payment returns only MATCHED_EVIDENCE; result has no SUCCEEDED/PAID state or mutation.
Observation requires existing typed webhookInboxId or auditLogId evidence references; an authenticated boolean is not accepted. Schema parsing is explicitly not authentication.
boundaries: Caller must bind immutable quote/account/environment/attempt/fiat amount and entire asset config to persisted business facts before evaluating; two supplied matching objects do not prove authority.

Trusted adapter must verify/persist original evidence, deduplicate included deposits, and supply minimum confirmations across every included deposit. This helper performs no network verification, persistence, replay ledger or payment-state change.
Generic gateway does not enable STABLECOIN. Actual merchant quote binding and a dedicated USDT adapter remain pending.
No actual chain, provider sandbox, financial settlement, wallet/private key, browser or full-repository verification was run in this slice.

officialReferences.use: Multiple supported protocols have explicit, protocol-specific token/contract/asset references; no chain is hardcoded here.
Confirming, partial deposits, wrong assets and configurable finished labels are distinct; exact amounts and network facts must be assessed independently.

superChecks: Single purpose: stablecoin wire contracts / pure exact assessment and conversion.
Flow is unknown input -> contract parse -> pure calculation -> serializable result.
Gateway imports contracts only; no circular dependencies.
Cross-module objects have Zod schemaVersion=1 schemas.
Amounts serialize as strings; BigInt remains internal.
No concrete network/token/URL/key/provider/FX defaults in implementation.
Only existing declared contracts/zod dependencies are used.
No services or persistence required to replace/test this slice.
All 72 affected tests and owned source strict types/format/lint passed.
